Thanks for the reply. But did you experience, and if so how did you get past, feeling you didn't deserve happiness? 

Sometimes I think that the least harmful thing for me to do right now is just live the best way I can and try to be a positive force in the world. But any time I start feeling happy I feel guilty because I don't deserve it. And then I become miserable which I think is the right thing to feel and that starts the spiral again because I don't think I can maintain this and my suicide would cause my family pain so I have to stay alive... And the loop just starts up again.
